characters.name: Noa
characters.description: girl about 6, small and round-faced, curly dark-brown hair tied with a yellow ribbon, big brown eyes, light-brown skin, long-sleeved long green linen dress, brown leather sandals

characters.name: Doll
characters.description: Noa's rag doll, small and floppy, patched together from blue, red and cream scraps, yarn hair of brown wool, two button eyes, a tiny stitched smile

characters.name: Mother
characters.description: Noa's mother, woman about 30, slim, gentle smile, light-brown skin, hair covered by a long terracotta head cloth, long sand-colored linen dress with a striped sash

characters.name: Father
characters.description: Noa's father, man about 35, broad-shouldered, short black beard, laughing brown eyes, light-brown skin, brown wool tunic with a rope belt, off-white head cloth, walking stick

characters.name: Grandma
characters.description: Noa's grandmother, small and plump, about 70, wrinkled kind face, grey hair under a deep-blue head cloth, long dark-olive dress, a woven shawl over her shoulders

cover.prompt: Noa holds a large round thin matzah up to her face and snaps off a piece with a happy grin, crumbs flying, her rag doll tucked under her arm. Behind her, her family walks out of a small mud-brick house at dawn, Father with a stick, Mother carrying a cloth-wrapped bowl on her shoulder, Grandma with a bundle. Golden sunrise over the desert road. Joyful medium shot.

pages.prompt: Inside a small mud-brick house in Egypt, evening lamplight. Noa sits on a woven mat hugging her rag doll, ears perked, while in the background Mother, Father and Grandma lean together whispering with excited, secretive faces. Clay pots, a small window, simple shelves. Noa's curious face as the focus.

Noa looks out of her small window. Outside, the Egyptian street is covered in a heavy deep-blue darkness, with a few cartoonish, harmless grasshoppers sitting on bare branches. Inside, Noa's home glows with warm golden light, Grandma lighting a lamp behind her. Strong contrast of cozy warm interior and calm dark outside, not scary.

Father bursts through the wooden door of the house with a huge smile, arms wide. Noa jumps into the air with excitement, her doll flying in her hand; Mother and Grandma turn with surprised joyful faces. Evening light streams in behind Father. Lively, energetic scene inside the small home.

Busy packing inside the house: Mother folds clothes into a basket, Grandma ties blankets into a bundle with rope, and in the front Noa carefully places her rag doll into her own small cloth bag, with a serious, important face. Lamps lit, things everywhere. Cheerful bustle, wide interior shot.

The family sits around a low table in the evening, eating together, but everyone wears sandals on their feet, a belt tied around the waist, and holds a walking stick in one hand. Noa looks down at her own sandals and stick with a puzzled giggle; Father leans toward her whispering with a wink. Grandma and Mother smile. Warm lamplight, slightly high angle.

Close-up of the low table: a clay platter of roasted meat, a bunch of green bitter leaves, and a stack of round thin flat matzot. Noa's hands break a matzah with a loud crack, crumbs flying, her eyes wide and delighted. Family hands reaching in at the edges. Warm golden lamp glow.

Night. Noa lies on her sleeping mat under a blanket, still wearing her sandals, hugging her rag doll, eyes wide open, gazing at a small window full of stars. A tiny oil lamp flickers. Quiet, dreamy, excited mood, soft blue and gold light. Close framing from above.

Early morning in the house. Mother kneads dough in a big clay bowl with flour on her arms, laughing. Noa stands on tiptoe beside her, peering into the bowl, asking with a curious face. Pale dawn light through the window, packed bundles by the door.

Mother lifts the cloth-wrapped bowl of dough onto her shoulder while Noa helps push it up with both hands, straining with a big effort face. Through the open door, people in the street raise their arms and call out. Father and Grandma grab bundles. Dynamic doorway scene, morning sun.

A huge joyful crowd streams out of the mud-brick houses onto the road: grandparents, parents, children, babies in arms, sheep, goats and cows, bundles on shoulders. In the middle, Noa walks holding Father's hand and her doll, Mother with the dough bowl and Grandma beside them. Wide panoramic shot, golden morning, dust glowing.

Resting by the roadside in the desert. Mother bakes flat matzot on a hot stone over a small fire. Noa bites a corner of a matzah with a crunch, eyes squeezed in delight. Grandma sits beside her on a bundle, wagging a finger gently as she explains. Afternoon light, sandy hills, a goat nibbling nearby.

Noa stands on a small rise at the edge of the road, hugging her rag doll. She looks back over her shoulder at the little mud-brick house far behind, then forward toward a long road winding into the open desert under a wide bright sky. Back view, three-quarter, wind in her hair. Peaceful, hopeful mood.

Present-day Israeli family at a Passover seder table at night: candles, a seder plate, wine cups, a matzah cover. A smiling girl of about six breaks a matzah with a crack, and in a soft dreamy cloud-like bubble above the table, Noa from long ago breaks a matzah too, as if the two girls are smiling at each other across time. Warm, festive light.
